goal: Transform poll drops to once a second when idle; a 'Test Ripple Delete' probe can tell, live, whether ripple remove can replace Rough Cut's per-piece moves

criteria.statement: Idle Transform poll reads at most ~1/s (was 40 reads in 6 s)
Ripple probe edits only a copy, aims a cut over empty space before a later clip, and reports mismatch/exact against the real Rough Cut plan; reachable from the diagnostics menu
All panel tests including the Adobe API check stay green
